display.purpose: Rare product-level moments and empty states.

body.purpose: Editor controls, properties, and instructional text.

shadows.name: hairline-lift
shadows.purpose: Stable bordered cards and editor sections.

motion.name: state-feedback
motion.purpose: Compact hover, focus, and selection feedback.

motion.name: pressed
motion.purpose: Tactile button activation without layout movement.

motion.name: reduced-motion

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action in a focused workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--brand-primary); color: #fff; font: 500 14px Inter, sans-serif; transition: filter 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action with visible structure.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--brand-border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--brand-surface); color: var(--brand-text); font: 500 14px Inter, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--brand-primary-50); color: var(--brand-primary); border-color: var(--brand-primary-200); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-emphasis action within dense editor chrome.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: transparent; color: var(--brand-secondary); font: 500 14px Inter, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--brand-primary-50); color: var(--brand-primary); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Editor Field
components.description: A compact text field for labels and properties.
components.css: .ds-editor-field { height: 40px; width: 240px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--brand-border); border-radius: var(--brand-radius); background: var(--brand-surface); color: var(--brand-text); font: 400 14px Inter, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-editor-field:hover { border-color: var(--brand-primary-200); } .ds-editor-field:focus-visible { border-color: var(--brand-primary-300); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(233, 84, 32, 0.15); }

components.name: Section Card
components.description: A stable grouping surface for editor settings.
components.css: .ds-section-card { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 240px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--brand-border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--brand-background); color: var(--brand-text); box-shadow: var(--shadow-xs); font: 400 14px Inter, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-section-card strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-section-card span { color: var(--brand-secondary); font-size: 12px; } .ds-section-card:hover { border-color: var(--brand-primary-200); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); } .ds-section-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Canvas Context Menu
components.description: A compact, keyboard-navigable canvas action surface.
components.css: .ds-context-menu { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 220px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--brand-border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--brand-surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); font: 400 14px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-context-menu button { padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--brand-secondary); text-align: left; } .ds-context-menu button:hover, .ds-context-menu button:focus-visible { background: var(--brand-background); color: var(--brand-text); outline: none; } .ds-context-menu hr { width: 100%; margin: 4px 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--brand-border); } .ds-context-menu .ds-danger { color: #b91c1c; } .ds-context-menu .ds-danger:hover, .ds-context-menu .ds-danger:focus-visible { background: #fef2f2; color: #b91c1c; }

narrative.overview: OpenFlowKit is a precise workspace, not a decorative canvas. Quiet neutral surfaces establish orientation, a single warm orange marks consequential action, and compact controls stay close to the object being edited. The interface is calm at rest and immediate in motion.
keyCharacteristics: Technical, legible, and compact without becoming cramped.
Restrained at rest; tactile during direct manipulation.
Consistent across React, DOM overlays, Canvas, WebGL, and exported output.
Responsive to system theme and reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Builder Orange is the only product accent. Do not add a second ornamental accent to make a screen feel more exciting.

rules.name: The Meaning Survives Color Rule
rules.body: Selection, error, warning, and connection states always retain a shape, label, icon, or stroke treatment when color is unavailable.

rules.name: The Canvas Owns the Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Editor chrome must not visually outrank the user's diagram through oversized type or heavy display treatment.

rules.name: The Flat Until Needed Rule
rules.body: Stable workspace surfaces remain nearly flat. Shadows become stronger only when z-order or interaction state must be understood.

dos: Do keep the diagram visually dominant and editor chrome compact.
Do use Builder Orange only for primary action, focus, selection, or active connection meaning.
Do use 4px, 6px, 8px, 12px, and 16px radii according to component depth.
Do preserve visible focus, reduced-motion behavior, keyboard operation, and non-color state cues.
Do make renderer changes visually consistent across DOM overlays, WebGL content, fallback rendering, and exports.
Do make errors recoverable and state whether the user's work remains safe.
donts: Don't build generic AI SaaS dashboards that make the assistant more prominent than the work.
Don't imitate playful sketch-only whiteboards that trade precision and semantics for novelty.
Don't recreate dense legacy enterprise diagram tools with modal-heavy, form-first workflows.
Don't add decorative futuristic GPU demos whose effects reduce legibility or predictability.
Don't introduce purple gradients, neon glow, glass-heavy surfaces, or competing accent colors as generic "innovation" styling.
Don't hide essential canvas actions behind pointer-only gestures or color-only feedback.
